description: Re-crawl your site and update what Clara knows about it. Trials skip the crawl at creation to stay fast, so Clara knows nothing about your business until this runs at least once. Can take up to a minute for a large site. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.

secret_key.description: The secret_key returned by create_trial_tenant, if your client can't send it as an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header instead.

name: refresh_site_knowledge
title: Refresh Site Knowledge
